content:
Leo: ok team, idea: 'Festive Zoom Backgrounds + Holiday Pun-off' this week? post a background (png/jpg link) and your best one-liner pun. top picks get a $15 coffee card + custom background pack. :coffee::sparkles:
Priya: love that. categories? best background, best pun, and combo (both). voting by reactions. deadline thursday 3pm PT.
Sam: i'm bringing a 'bad holiday movie set' background. pun: "Yule be sorry if you don't join."
Jules: i'm in. can we have a 'family-friendly' tag for puns so HR doesn't cry 😂
Leo: good call. add tags: #family-friendly and #cheeky. festival-bot will filter nothing, so please self-label.
festive-bot: Reminder: post your entries with tag #festive-bg by 2026-01-08 15:00 PT. React with :white_check_mark: to RSVP.
Priya: RSVP'd ✅ caption: "Aurora Borealis from my living room" pic: https://files.redwood.example/bg-priya-aurora.jpg #family-friendly
Sam: posted pic: https://files.redwood.example/bg-sam-movie-set.jpg caption: "Set decorator on a budget" #cheeky pun: "Sleigh my name, sleigh my name."
Jules: posted pic: https://files.redwood.example/bg-jules-cozy-cabin.jpg caption: "Cabin fever, but make it aesthetic" #family-friendly pun: "Tree-mendous vibes."
Leo: posted pic: https://files.redwood.example/bg-leo-winter-cyberpunk.jpg caption: "Neo-Noel in neon" #cheeky pun: "Have an ice day."
Priya: also throwing in a silly holiday hat overlay if anyone wants it: https://files.redwood.example/hat-overlay.png
Sam: voting plan: run community vote for People's Choice (emoji reactions) and cap judges for "Combo" category (me + Leo). Judges pick by Friday noon.
Jules: reacted with :sparkles: to Priya, :clap: to Sam
Leo: reacted :sparkles: to Jules, :star: to Priya
festive-bot: Poll created: People's Choice ends 2026-01-08 15:00 PT. Use reactions to vote.
Sam: small rules note: please avoid copyrighted movie screenshots. make it original-ish or a stylized nod.
Priya: noted. also promise to judge puns fairly (but i may be bribed with cookies).
Jules: pun entries are already top-tier. someone made a spreadsheet?
Leo: simple tally in thread. i'll post winners saturday morning and push the background pack to winners.
Sam: caption addendum: "inspired by low-budget sleigh shots"
Priya: pun addendum: "I'm snow excited."
Jules: pun addendum: "Don't be a grinch, join the pinch!"
Leo: last reminder: RSVP if you want our tiny Xmas playlist in the pack. happy punning and backgrounding :headphones:
